thought.title: Thought of the day
thought.1: Hug a little longer than usual today.
thought.2: Small thank-yous make a big day.
thought.3: The best part of the day is the evening together.
thought.4: A great day to say «I’m proud of you».
thought.5: Coffee tastes better when your favourite person made it.
thought.6: Praise something today you usually don’t notice.
thought.7: Five minutes without phones — just the two of you.
thought.8: Do something nice today for no reason.
thought.10: Remember your best trip together today.
thought.11: Holding hands is a conversation too.
